title_en: Deng Yucai, Yu Min, Sui Guohua, Wang Jiaqi — theft of special VAT invoices

full_text_en:
Deng Yucai, Yu Min, Sui Guohua, Wang Jiaqi — theft of special VAT invoices

Defendants:

Deng Yucai, male, 37 years old, formerly an employee on leave without pay of Harbin Changhong Chemical Pigment Factory, Heilongjiang Province. Arrested on May 7, 1994.

Yu Min, male, 30 years old, formerly a released prisoner, unemployed. In November 1978, sentenced to two years of reeducation through labor for theft; in September 1980, sentenced to one year and six months of fixed-term imprisonment for theft; in August 1982, sentenced to eight years of fixed-term imprisonment for multiple crimes including escape, theft, and theft of firearms; in March 1983, sentenced to 17 years of fixed-term imprisonment for multiple crimes including escape, theft, and robbery. Released on commutation on November 29, 1993. Arrested on May 7, 1994.

Sui Guohua, male, 38 years old, formerly a released prisoner, unemployed. In October 1980, sentenced to two years and six months of fixed-term imprisonment for multiple crimes including theft and harboring stolen goods; in September 1985, sentenced to 15 years of fixed-term imprisonment for habitual theft. Released on commutation in August 1993. Arrested on May 7, 1994.

Wang Jiaqi, male, 32 years old, formerly a released prisoner, unemployed. In September 1980, sentenced to one year and six months of fixed-term imprisonment for theft; in September 1985, sentenced to 10 years of fixed-term imprisonment for habitual theft. Released on commutation on February 22, 1992. Arrested on May 7, 1994.

The People's Procuratorate of Harbin City, Heilongjiang Province, instituted a public prosecution against the defendants Deng Yucai, Yu Min, Sui Guohua, and Wang Jiaqi for the crime of theft, and submitted the case to the Intermediate People's Court of Harbin City, Heilongjiang Province. The Intermediate People's Court of Harbin City, after a public trial, found the following facts:

On March 3, 1994, the defendant Deng Yucai proposed to the defendants Sui Guohua and Wang Jiaqi the idea of stealing special VAT invoices for sale. Sui Guohua and Wang Jiaqi agreed. Sui Guohua then recruited the defendant Yu Min. On March 4, 1994, Deng Yucai, Sui Guohua, Wang Jiaqi, and Yu Min went to the Acheng City Tax Bureau, Heilongjiang Province, to reconnoiter. Subsequently, Deng Yucai and Wang Jiaqi returned to Harbin City. At approximately 2:00 a.m. on March 5, Sui Guohua and Yu Min pried open the door of the Acheng City Tax Bureau's report warehouse, but found no special VAT invoices inside; the theft attempt failed. Thereafter, Deng Yucai proposed stealing special VAT invoices from the Hulan County Tax Bureau. In the afternoon of March 5, Deng Yucai, Yu Min, and Sui Guohua (Wang Jiaqi did not go due to other matters) traveled to the Hulan County Tax Bureau, Heilongjiang Province, to reconnoiter. At approximately 6:00 p.m., when Deng Yucai, Yu Min, and Sui Guohua broke the window glass of the warehouse where invoices were stored and were about to commit theft, they saw someone moving about and fled the scene. At approximately 11:00 p.m., with Deng Yucai acting as lookout outside and Sui Guohua providing backup, Yu Min sneaked into the warehouse and stole 800 sets (40,000 copies) of duplicate special VAT invoices. That night, they hired a vehicle to transport the invoices to Wang Jiaqi's home in Harbin. Seeing that the stolen invoices were all duplicates, Deng Yucai proposed stealing original invoices and asked Wang Jiaqi to join. In the early morning of March 6, Deng Yucai and the other three again traveled by vehicle to the Hulan County Tax Bureau warehouse; Wang Jiaqi stayed with the vehicle, Sui Guohua provided backup, and Deng Yucai and Yu Min sneaked into the warehouse and stole 800 sets (40,000 copies) of original special VAT invoices. On March 6 and 7 of the same year, Deng Yucai sold six sets of original special VAT invoices, obtaining illicit proceeds of RMB 8,000; Yu Min and Sui Guohua each received RMB 3,000 from the proceeds. After the case was discovered, Deng Yucai and Wang Jiaqi burned part of the remaining invoices.

After committing the crime, defendant Wang Jiaqi surrendered to the public security authorities, confessed his criminal acts, exposed the crimes of his co-defendants, and led the public security officers to arrest Deng Yucai, Yu Min, and Sui Guohua.

Separately, between December 1993 and March 1994, defendant Yu Min committed three separate thefts in Harbin and Jixi cities, stealing treasury bonds, cameras, and other items valued at over RMB 3,400 in total.

The above facts are confirmed by: the theft reports from the Hulan County and Acheng City tax bureaus; testimony from witnesses who purchased special VAT invoices from Deng Yucai; a fingerprint lifted from the scene, identified as belonging to Yu Min's left index finger; partial special VAT invoices seized; and the confessions of all four defendants, which are consistent with and corroborate each other.

The Intermediate People's Court of Harbin City held that the defendants Deng Yucai, Sui Guohua, Yu Min, and Wang Jiaqi jointly committed criminal acts, constituting joint intentional crime as defined in Article 22 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China. Deng Yucai proposed stealing national special VAT invoices, planned and organized the joint commission of the crime, and after the crime, divided the proceeds and destroyed evidence; Yu Min and Sui Guohua actively participated in stealing national special VAT invoices, twice sneaking into tax bureau warehouses to commit theft; Wang Jiaqi actively participated in the criminal conspiracy and, after the crime, destroyed evidence. Pursuant to Article 23 of the Criminal Law, all are principals in the crime of theft. The defendants Deng Yucai, Yu Min, Sui Guohua, and Wang Jiaqi jointly stole 40,000 copies of original special VAT invoices and 40,000 copies of duplicate special VAT invoices. According to Article 4 of the "Provisions on the Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases of Counterfeiting, Trafficking, and Stealing Invoices" jointly issued by the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate, which states: "Those who steal special VAT invoices shall be investigated for criminal responsibility for the crime of theft," their actions all constitute the crime of theft. Deng Yucai, Yu Min, Sui Guohua, and Wang Jiaqi stole special VAT invoices, seriously disrupting the economic order and the country's tax reform; the circumstances are particularly serious. In accordance with the above judicial interpretation, they should be severely punished pursuant to Article 1(1) of the "Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Severely Punishing Criminals Who Seriously Undermine the Economy." Defendants Yu Min, Sui Guohua, and Wang Jiaqi, having been sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment for crimes and after serving their sentences, committed crimes punishable by fixed-term imprisonment or more within three years; pursuant to Article 61(1) of the Criminal Law, they are recidivists and should be given heavier punishment. Defendant Wang Jiaqi surrendered after committing the crime, exposed others' crimes, and assisted the public security authorities in arresting his co-defendants; pursuant to Article 63 of the Criminal Law, he may be given a lighter punishment. Pursuant to Article 53(1) of the Criminal Law, Deng Yucai, Sui Guohua, and Yu Min shall be deprived of political rights for life; pursuant to Article 52 of the Criminal Law, Wang Jiaqi shall be additionally deprived of political rights. Accordingly, on June 10, 1994, the Intermediate People's Court of Harbin City rendered the following judgment:

Defendants Deng Yucai, Yu Min, and Sui Guohua were each sentenced to death for the crime of theft, with deprivation of political rights for life;

Defendant Wang Jiaqi was sentenced to 13 years of fixed-term imprisonment for the crime of theft, with deprivation of political rights for two years.

After the first-instance judgment was pronounced, all defendants—Deng Yucai, Yu Min, Sui Guohua, and Wang Jiaqi—appealed to the High People's Court of Heilongjiang Province on the ground that the sentences were too severe. Defense counsel for Yu Min in the second instance argued that Yu Min was an accessory in the joint crime.

The High People's Court of Heilongjiang Province, upon trial, held that the appellants Deng Yucai, Yu Min, Sui Guohua, and Wang Jiaqi had formed a group to steal national special VAT invoices; the amount was huge, the circumstances were particularly serious, and all were principals in the case, thus warranting severe punishment according to law. Appellant Wang Jiaqi surrendered after committing the crime and exposed others' crimes; the first-instance court had already given him a lighter punishment. The first-instance court, based on the facts of the crimes, circumstances, and individual culpability of appellants Deng Yucai, Yu Min, Sui Guohua, and Wang Jiaqi, had correctly characterized the crimes and imposed appropriate sentences; the grounds for appeal were untenable. In accordance with Article 136(1) of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the court ruled to dismiss the appeals of Deng Yucai, Yu Min, Sui Guohua, and Wang Jiaqi and to affirm the original judgment.

Pursuant to the authorization from the Supreme People's Court to approve certain death penalty cases, the High People's Court of Heilongjiang Province approved the death sentences with deprivation of political rights for life imposed on defendants Deng Yucai, Yu Min, and Sui Guohua for the crime of theft.
